integrity: The all-order bound and equality characterization follow from the written inclusion-exclusion and dual-multigraph proof.
The included exact enumeration is supplementary evidence for small orders, not the proof for all orders.
Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns independent five-sets in finite simple 3-uniform 2-regular hypergraphs of order \(n\ge9\).
It does not settle other coefficients, uniformities, degrees, or the full independent-set polynomial.
title: Fifth-coefficient extremizers for 2-regular triple systems
